method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation No. 136, compilation date 19 September 2026 (includes amendments up to Act No. 90, 2026; register id C2026C00411), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A00101.txt; with the Health Insurance Regulations 2018, Compilation No. 26, compilation date 1 July 2026 (register id F2026C00551), as deposited at ../../../health-insurance-regulations-2018/registers/source-bundle/F2018L01365.txt (ss 28(1) table item 1, 65B, 65C(6), 90)

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the patient (the Medicare-eligible person): s 3(1) (Australian resident, eligible overseas representative, eligible person, public hospital service, public patient, recognised hospital); ss 6, 6A, 7 (their effect, as facts); s 8(1A) (concessional person, FTB(A) family, patient contribution, the safety-net amounts of $246, $500, $500 and $2,000 as indexed inputs); s 9; s 10(1)-(5) (75%, 85% and 100% of the Schedule fee; the $50.00 greatest permissible gap; rounding up to 5 cents), with Regulations s 28(1) Group A1 at 100%; ss 10AC, 10AD (the original safety net: threshold claim and the increase by the patient contribution); ss 10ACA, 10ADA (the extended safety net: 20% paid directly, the lowest applicable threshold, 80% of out-of-pocket expenses; the straddling formula missing from the deposit is an input); s 14(1); s 17(1)(a); s 19(1)-(6); s 20(1), (2); s 20A(1) with Regulations ss 65B, 65C(6) (bulk billing and what the patient then pays); s 128C with Regulations s 90 (no charging a public patient, for childbirth only; 50 penalty units). Schedule fees (the General Medical Services Table is not deposited) and the s 6A regulations are inputs. Not encoded: ss 15-16G, 19AA-19AI, simplified billing, claims, family registration mechanics, s 10B caps, indexation mechanics, Parts IIA onwards except s 128C; compensation recovery is not in this Act.
